title: The rooms' handle is called RoomDirectory; find takes an optional kind: the room is found only if it is of that kind
covers: a handle kind renamed, its list of members the same
a member of it changed in the same job (accepts more)
a user hands that member on as a value
note: front's Z07 test maps ids through rooms.find: map hands the index as the kind, no room is found, and the test fails. bookings names Rooms (its @import), so it is told of the rename; front does not name it.
